subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Sullen
solution:
The correct answer is "**Grim**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sullen **means being in a **bad mood **and avoiding to speak to people. 

 
 
• **Example:** *Anne is **sullen** as she is sick.*
 
 
 
• **Grim** means **not being in a pleasant mood**.
 
 
• **Example**: *Fred seems **grim** after knowing his test results.* 
 
 
 
• Therefore, Grim is the appropriate synonym of Sullen. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dazzling **- shiny.

 
 
• **Example:** *The Bride's dress was **dazzling** during the reception.*
 
 
 
• **Smart** - intelligent .
 
 
• **Example:** *Lee is **smart** enough to solve this puzzle.* 
 
 
 
• **Bright** - full of light.
 
 
• Example: *The headlights were very **bright.** *
